# How to Download TikTok Images Online: A Step-by-Step Guide

TikTok is not only a platform where people upload short videos. Many users also share photo posts containing pictures from their trips, creative designs, recipes, fashion trends, and other interesting content.

Sometimes, you may find TikTok photos that you would like to save to your phone or computer. Rather than returning to the original post every time you want to view those pictures, you may prefer to keep copies on your device.

A TikTok photo downloader can help you do that.

Using TikSaveMP4, you can download images from supported public TikTok photo posts directly through your web browser. You can download individual photos or multiple selected images together in a ZIP file.

In this guide, we'll explain how to download TikTok images online, save several photos, and solve common downloading problems.

## What Is a TikTok Photo Downloader?

A TikTok photo downloader is an online service that allows users to download images from supported TikTok photo posts.

Although TikTok is well known for short videos, it also allows creators to share multiple pictures in a single post. These are commonly called TikTok photo slideshows or carousel posts.

When you find a public TikTok photo post, a compatible image downloader can retrieve the available pictures and provide options for saving them.

TikSaveMP4 supports individual photo downloads as well as selected-image ZIP downloads for compatible public posts.

Unlike taking screenshots, downloading an available image file may avoid capturing interface elements surrounding the picture, such as buttons, navigation controls, and captions.

However, the available images and their quality depend on the original TikTok post.

## How to Download TikTok Images Online

You can use the TikSaveMP4 online TikTok image downloader by following these steps.

### Step 1: Find a Public TikTok Photo Post

Open the TikTok app or website using your smartphone or computer.

Find a public photo post containing the images you want to download.

Click or tap the Share button and select Copy link.

Make sure the copied URL belongs to the correct photo post.

### Step 2: Visit the TikSaveMP4 Website

Visit [TikSaveMP4](https://tiksavemp4.online/) through a compatible web browser.

You'll see an input field where you can paste the URL of your TikTok photo post.

No additional downloader application or TikSaveMP4 account registration is required.

### Step 3: Paste the TikTok Photo URL

Paste the copied photo post URL into the website's input field.

Submit the link and wait for TikSaveMP4 to analyze it.

If the photo post is publicly accessible and supported, the available images will appear.

### Step 4: Select the Pictures You Want to Download

Review the pictures displayed by the downloader.

You can download an individual image or select multiple pictures, depending on the available options.

If you only need one picture, use its individual download option.

If you want several images from the same post, select the pictures you wish to save.

### Step 5: Download the TikTok Images

Choose the appropriate download option.

For individual photos, save the available image files to your device.

If you've selected several images, TikSaveMP4 can prepare a ZIP file containing your chosen pictures.

The download process may vary depending on your browser and device.

Once the download finishes, you can view your images using a compatible photo viewer.

## How to Download Multiple TikTok Images as a ZIP File

Some TikTok photo posts contain multiple pictures.

Instead of downloading every image separately, you may prefer to save your selected images together.

TikSaveMP4 allows users to download selected images in a ZIP file from supported public photo posts.

Follow these steps:

1. Copy the URL of a supported TikTok photo post.
2. Paste the URL into TikSaveMP4 and submit it.
3. Wait until the available images appear.
4. Select the pictures you want to download.
5. Choose the ZIP download option.
6. Save the ZIP file to your device.

A ZIP file is a compressed archive containing multiple files in one package.

After downloading it, you can extract the archive to access the individual images.

Keep in mind that the selected-image ZIP feature depends on the available images and whether the original post is supported.

## TikTok to Image vs TikTok to MP4: What's the Difference?

TikTok to image and TikTok to MP4 refer to two different types of downloads.

TikTok to image generally means downloading pictures from TikTok photo posts.

TikTok to MP4 refers to downloading supported TikTok video posts in MP4 format.

If a TikTok post contains a video, an MP4 download may be appropriate.

If the post contains several pictures, an image download may be more useful.

TikSaveMP4 supports both types of downloads when the original public post and available formats are compatible.

However, downloading images from a TikTok photo post is different from converting a TikTok video into individual image frames.

The TikSaveMP4 photo downloader works with supported photo posts, not video-to-image conversion.

For video downloads, read our [TikTok to MP4 guide](https://tiksavemp4.online/blog/how-to-convert-tiktok-to-mp4).

## Can You Download TikTok Slideshows?

Some TikTok posts contain a series of images that users can swipe through.

These posts are commonly called TikTok slideshows or photo carousels.

The term TikTok slideshow downloader often refers to a tool that saves the individual images contained in these posts.

TikSaveMP4 can make available photos from supported public image posts accessible for downloading, including multiple selected images in a ZIP file.

However, this does not mean every slideshow can be converted into an MP4 video.

Available download options depend on the original TikTok post.

## Why Isn't My TikTok Photo Download Working?

Sometimes, a TikTok photo download may fail or certain images may be unavailable.

Here are some common reasons.

### The TikTok Post Is Private

TikSaveMP4 processes supported public TikTok photo posts.

It does not bypass private or login-restricted content.

### The TikTok Link Is Incorrect

Make sure you've entered the complete URL of the photo post.

An incomplete or invalid link may prevent the downloader from locating the content.

### The Photos Are Unavailable

Pictures from some posts may have been removed, restricted, or changed.

If TikTok no longer makes the images available, the downloader may not be able to retrieve them.

### A Temporary Processing Error Occurred

Network problems or changes to upstream services can interrupt the downloading process.

If an error occurs, wait a while and try again with a supported public post.

### The ZIP File Cannot Be Opened

Make sure the ZIP download has finished successfully.

Try extracting the ZIP file using your device's built-in archive utility or a compatible file manager.

If the archive is incomplete or corrupted, try downloading the selected images again.
